acceptance: A batch-member-check refusal names the failing preflight step and test.
description:
## Problem
When `make pr-preflight` fails inside `make batch-member-check`, the refusal prints "REFUSED: preflight failed: <last stderr lines>". On 2026-11-21 those lines were the primary clone's stale-skills WARNING from `scripts/check_primary_clone_clean.sh`, while the real failure was one pytest test; a member agent misread the warning as the cause and stopped. The failing step was only findable in the preflight receipt JSON.

## Change
Make the refusal name the failed receipt step(s) and the first failing test (from the receipt), and the receipt path, rather than the stderr tail.

## Decision gates
Message-only change; no change to what passes or fails. New message text follows existing conventions and is listed in the pull request.

## Verification rubric
A test with a failing preflight receipt asserts the refusal names the failing step and test and not a warning line; `make pr-preflight` exits 0.

## Guardrails
Work in a linked worktree (`make worktree-create`), never the primary clone. Edit files with the edit tool, never by script. Heavy work (benchmarks, test tiers, UAT, generators at scale) only through `make heavy-run` or lock-taking entry points; never skip the lock, admission or watchdog; never delete anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`. No live cloud run and no cloud credentials unless this item's Decision gates say the owner approved it in the current task. BenchBox imposes no default run limit: add none. No comments or docstrings in first-party code; one changelog fragment for a user-facing change. Never post a stand-in review, close and reopen a pull request to restart CI, use `--no-verify`, force-push, or rewrite an author. Arm once; a second time only after fixing the cause the refusal named. Reply on every review thread; resolve it only after the bot's review of the new head does not raise it again.
